authoritative_full_relevant_source_reads.proof_read: The inverse limit of H0(nE,O_n) is a complete regular local ring with maximal ideal powers, from P1 conormal cohomology and two lifted generators. Noetherian Stein factorization and formal functions identify a new target local completion with that ring. Invertible centre ideal and conormal comparison recover the blowup. Twist vanishing builds L(nE), which collapses E and is quasi-finite off it; Picard descent and gluing preserve (quasi-)projectivity.
